title: krn ledger reads a large merged-PR list instead of timing out at 5 s
body:
Source: lead session 2026-11-16: `krn ledger --since 2026-11-09 --limit 400` and `--limit 1000` exit 70 "Unable to read merged PR list with gh" (src/outcome/ledger.ts collectLedger), while the same `gh pr list --state merged --limit 420 --json ...` succeeds in 3.3 s by hand. Cause: defaultRun = callRun(CALL_TIMEOUT_MS = 5000) applies the per-row 5 s timeout to the one list call whose latency grows with --limit; the catch hides the timeout.
Outcome: the merged-PR list call gets a timeout sized for its limit (or a separate list timeout), and the internal error names the cause (timeout vs parse); `krn ledger --limit 1000` succeeds on this repository.
Proof: test/outcome/ledger.test.ts sizes the list timeout for 1,020 rows above twice the measured latency and sees execFile kill a call past its budget, and `bin/krn ledger --since 2026-11-09 --limit 700` exits 0.
Files: src/outcome/ledger.ts
